pressure_definition: A pressure delivery is any ball (a) in a chase with the required rate between 9 and 18, or with 30 or fewer balls left and a required rate up to 15, or (b) bowled with 3+ wickets down inside the first 8 overs, or 5+ wickets down inside the first 15 overs. Rain-reduced chases are excluded from (a) because revised targets are not available.
